reasons: CS3227 is required in Y3S2 (Sem 6), but its prerequisite CS2103 is not completed or planned in Sem 6 or earlier.
CS3237 requires CS2100 (completed) and an EE/CG hardware course (none completed), making it ineligible without adding a blocked course.
CS3231 requires CS1231 or CS1231S (completed) and CS2040/CS2040S (completed), so it is eligible, but the conflict with CS3227 in Sem 6 and prerequisites for CS3237 prevent a valid plan.
